title: Recovered work
originalRequest: Develop and validate core database structures, transactional APIs, external mapping integrations, and reporting tools for managing a community seed library inventory and botanical taxonomy database.
latestMessage: Develop and validate core database structures, transactional APIs, external mapping integrations, and reporting tools for managing a community seed library inventory and botanical taxonomy database.

steps.title: Define Botanical Taxonomy Schema and Database Constraints
steps.instruction: Research and define a SQL schema for botanical classifications (family, genus, species, common name, and germination requirements) compatible with PostgreSQL.
steps.acceptance: Schema handles hierarchical lookups efficiently and prevents duplicate entries for identical species.
steps.result: First attempt to model taxonomy as a single flat table failed to handle complex sub-species and variants. Second attempt using an adjacency list model successfully normalized the schema. SQL DDL generated and validated against test dataset.

steps.title: Implement Seed Inventory Transaction API
steps.instruction: Develop backend API endpoints for check-out (donation) and check-in (return/harvest) of seeds, updating stock levels.
steps.acceptance: API endpoints POST /inventory/checkout and POST /inventory/return handle transaction logging and atomicity.
steps.result: Successfully completed on first attempt. Implemented Django REST framework serializers and views with atomic transactions to prevent double-allocation of rare seed lots.

steps.title: Integrate USDA Hardiness Zone Mapping
steps.instruction: Create a utility to map user zip codes to USDA climate zones to recommend appropriate planting times.
steps.acceptance: Utility resolves standard US zip codes to hardiness zones within 500ms.
steps.result: Attempt 1 failed because the local JSON mapping file was corrupted during parsing. Attempt 2 resolved this by migrating to a binary search tree lookup using a cleaned CSV dataset. All unit tests now pass.

steps.title: Integrate Public Seed Variety Image API
steps.instruction: Integrate with an open-source botanical image database API to dynamically fetch and display seed images.
steps.acceptance: Images are fetched and rendered asynchronously for each catalog item.
steps.result: Blocked during the first attempt. The target open-source botanical image API has deprecation warnings and currently returns 503 Service Unavailable errors on all endpoint requests. Need an alternative image source or fallback placeholders.

steps.title: Validate Seed Purity and Viability Tracking Data
steps.instruction: Run consistency checks on validation logs to ensure that germination rate percentages and harvest years are mathematically valid.
steps.acceptance: Validation script flag errors where germination_rate > 100% or harvest_year is in the future.
steps.result: Attempt 1 failed due to floating-point errors in percentage parsing. Attempt 2 failed because timezone offsets marked valid harvest dates as future dates. Attempt 3 succeeded by converting all timestamps to UTC prior to logic checks and using decimal types for germination rates.

steps.title: Export Catalog to CSV/PDF Utility
steps.instruction: Implement a reporting service allowing administrators to export the current catalog to a downloadable format.
steps.acceptance: Export formats include standard CSV and printable PDF containing species name, stock level, and shelf location.
steps.result: Successfully completed on first attempt using ReportLab for PDF generation and Python's native CSV library. Output matches specified page layout constraints.
